claim.claim-text: 1. Encoded video data comprising an encoded intra prediction mode for a block, wherein all intra prediction modes either belong to a most probable modes, MPM, list or to remaining modes, wherein 6 modes are in the MPM list and 61 modes in the remaining modes and all of the remaining modes are coded using truncated binary coding, and wherein the intra prediction mode is encoded using 5 bits when the intra prediction mode is one of a first three modes from the remaining modes, and the intra prediction mode is encoded using 6 bits when the intra prediction mode is outside the first three modes.
